changelog:
### Minor Changes

- e824859: Add `@shop-prompter/angular`, an Angular component for the `<shop-prompter>` Web Component (Angular 19 or higher).

  - Import the standalone `ShopPrompterComponent` and use `<shop-prompter>` in your templates. No `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA` is needed.
  - Typed inputs, passed to the element as DOM properties: `[apiConfig]`, `[chatPosition]`, `[theme]`, `[cart]` and the other options of the JavaScript SDK.
  - Outputs: `(cartOperation)`, `(productClick)`, `(navigation)` and `(closed)`. With a `(productClick)` handler the built-in product link is skipped.
  - A template reference (`#chat`) exposes `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`, `isOpen` and `element`.
  - `[dialogTrigger]` also accepts a template reference or an `ElementRef`.

### Patch Changes

- @shop-prompter/html@2.3.0

integration.description: The ShopPrompter® Angular SDK adds the AI shopping assistant to Angular applications as a typed, standalone `<shop-prompter>` component.
integration.overview:
Import `ShopPrompterComponent` and use `<shop-prompter>` in any template, with typed inputs for the configuration, theme and display mode. No `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA` is needed. It wraps the ShopPrompter® Web Component, so every display mode and theme option of the JavaScript SDK is available.

Handle `(cartOperation)` and `(productClick)` to connect the assistant to your cart and router, and use a template reference to open or close the chat from your own UI.

prerequisites.title: A ShopPrompter® API key or token
